default.title: Commerce order history and Shopify package imports
default.summary: ClawPilot now keeps provider-sourced Shopify and Faire order history, monitors bounded continuous updates, and lets operators import Shopify saved-package CSV files as reviewed packaging drafts.
features: A read-only 60-day Shopify order-history backfill with provider lifecycle, shipment, return, and line evidence
Provider-available Faire order history with five-minute overlap polling and truthful polling-only readiness
Seven signed core Shopify order signals with exact order reads and a scheduled polling backstop
Per-connection commerce authority and readiness evidence without enabling provider writes
CSV preview and draft import for Shopify saved packages, including dimensions, empty weight, and default-package evidence
fixes: Shopify order synchronization remains read-only and reports non-exhaustive signal coverage instead of claiming every provider change is webhook-driven
Faire no longer reports unavailable webhook capability as a realtime failure
Sensitive tracking and provider-staff evidence expires after the bounded retention window while minimized order history remains
Packaging materials can be removed safely: unused drafts are deleted and referenced materials are retired
Retired packaging materials cannot be restored through ordinary edits, imports, or stock updates
Shopify package imports are tenant-scoped, previewed, idempotent, draft-only, and perform no provider reads or writes
Shopify setup now exposes the complete required scope string with a reliable clipboard fallback and canonical store-domain handling
